task.title: Enforce AskUserQuestion tool for Q&A dialogue steps
task.description: Refactor the conduct_qa_dialogue step in festina-scope and festina-create skills to enforce proper use of the AskUserQuestion tool with one-question-at-a-time Socratic dialogue flow.
task.problem:
The conduct_qa_dialogue step in festina-scope and festina-create has vague instructions that allow the LLM to: 1. Output questions as text instead of using the AskUserQuestion tool 2. Ask multiple questions at once instead of one at a time
This results in poor UX where the user sees a wall of technical questions dumped as text, then the LLM continues without waiting for interactive input.
Source files: - apps/festinalente/src/content/skills/festina-scope/SKILL.md (lines 488-566) - Line 507: vague action "Share initial findings and ask questions" - Lines 540-549: output block instead of AskUserQuestion tool - apps/festinalente/src/content/skills/festina-create/SKILL.md - Line 288: mentions tool but doesn't enforce "one at a time"
task.value:
Users can actually answer questions interactively one at a time, maintaining a proper Socratic dialogue flow instead of being overwhelmed with questions they cannot respond to individually.
Working pattern exists in festina-map-engineering (line 327): - Explicit note: "Use AskUserQuestion tool for **one question at a time**." - Provides explicit question blocks with structured tool specifications
task.acceptance-criteria:
Given the LLM reaches the conduct_qa_dialogue step And it needs to ask a technical or product question When formulating the question Then it MUST use the AskUserQuestion tool (not text output) And it MUST ask ONE question at a time And it MUST wait for the answer before asking the next question
Given the LLM has gathered enough information When presenting the confirmation summary Then it MUST use AskUserQuestion tool to get explicit approval And it MUST NOT just output text and proceed
Given the existing conduct_qa_dialogue functionality When applying these changes Then all existing features (research branches, context gathering, etc.) MUST be preserved And only the question delivery mechanism changes
